description:
Activate a basic land, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing Strangleroot Geist.
Strangleroot Geist's undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Ghave's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control besides Strangleroot Geist.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Strangleroot Geist, untapping a basic land.
Activate a basic land, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Strangleroot Geist, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Saproling creature token, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.
